NAME:
   rancher auth login - Login to a Rancher server

USAGE:
   rancher auth login [options] [name]

OPTIONS:
   --auth-flow flow          identity-provider flow
   --auth-provider name      auth config name to sign in with (for example corp-ldap); a provider name or type such as openldap also works; with several matches the CLI asks, or lists them in the error
   --cacert path             PEM CA bundle, a path or the literal PEM, saved with the entry (requires --url); when absent, RANCHER_CLI_CACERT connects the login with or without --url, and is never saved
   --credential-store store  credential store this directory keeps its credentials in: auto, keychain, file or exec:<name>; a change of store takes only this entry's credential and needs the other entries logged out of the store being left first
   --help, -h                show help
   --no-verify               store the token without an authenticated round-trip against the server
   --token-stdin             read the API token (id:secret) from stdin
   --ttl duration            session-token lifetime duration, e.g. 90d
   --url url                 Rancher server url to add and log into; when name is omitted, the server's hostname becomes the entry name

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
